path_decisions.rationale: Pheromone strong (0.103). MACD params are not in any param_space — infrastructure fix needed before MACD can be tuned
With param_spaces defined, the N-of-M entry logic becomes optimizable. min_conditions should be in param_space
Entry + exit fixes compound: more entries from N-of-M + profit targets from early exit = higher win_rate
Win_rate objective in validation gate is the infrastructure capstone that makes all changes survive validation

candidate_solution.summary: End-to-end implementation plan: (1) param_space JSON files, (2) MACD crypto params, (3) min_conditions + N-of-M, (4) profit_target_mixin, (5) win_rate gate

implementation_order.change: Create per-strategy param_space JSON files with ALL tunable parameters
implementation_order.rationale: Infrastructure prerequisite — enables all other optimizations

implementation_order.change: Add win_rate objective to optimizer._objective_value() and validation gate
implementation_order.rationale: Must be done before any parameter tuning to avoid Sharpe-wins-over-win_rate trap

implementation_order.change: Add profit_target_exit() to _runtime.py shared across all templates
implementation_order.rationale: Highest single-impact change — converts marginal winners to guaranteed winners

implementation_order.change: Add min_conditions param to trend_following, mean_reversion, volatility_breakout
implementation_order.rationale: Second-highest impact — increases trade frequency with maintained quality

implementation_order.change: Add MACD fast/slow/signal ranges to trend_following param_space
Fix signal consolidation from net-vote to strength-weighted
implementation_order.rationale: Preserves high-conviction signals when strategies disagree

implementation_order.change: Add per-strategy risk budgets to RiskEngine
implementation_order.rationale: Prevents one-strategy drawdown from blocking uncorrelated strategies

implementation_order.change: Populate PositionSizer with actual per-strategy win_rate
implementation_order.rationale: Correct Kelly sizing improves risk/reward calibration

implementation_order.change: Reduce ATR multiplier default from 2.0 to 1.5 for trend_following
implementation_order.rationale: Less restrictive volatility filter allows more trend entries

notes: The key meta-insight across all 3 iterations: the system has 3 architectural gaps that compound to suppress win_rate: (1) NO profit target / trailing stop exits (signals reverse before profits are locked), (2) AND-logic entry filters that are too restrictive (few trades = low win_rate sampling), (3) Sharpe-optimized validation pipeline that selects against win_rate. Fixing any one alone helps; fixing all three is multiplicative.
